artworks.title: Taglia Cantoni and Fracasso
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two masked figures engaging in a sword fight. The image shows two elaborately costumed characters with large hats and feathers dueling with swords. Both figures are standing in a dynamic pose as they cross swords. In the background, there are sketch-like outlines of bystanders watching the duel, along with some trees and an architectural structure. The style is reminiscent of theatrical or comedia dell'arte costumes, reflected in the exaggerated clothing and dramatic stances of the figures. The words "Taglia Cantoni" and "Fracasso" are inscribed underneath the characters. The drawing emphasizes motion and dramatic expression.

artworks.title: Saint Amond
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.3 × 28.6 cm (8 × 11 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around a central character in a wooded area. The monochromatic image features a group of individuals in a natural setting, seemingly taking part in or observing a significant event, with the central figure standing prominently among the crowd. The central figure is visually distinguished with a halo-like glow. The gathering appears to be set within a forested landscape, with large trees framing the scene and a distant building visible in the background. The people are dressed in period clothing. The scene conveys a sense of attention and veneration directed towards the central character.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Varie Figure Gobbi" (Various Hunchback Figures)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring four figures depicted from the waist down. The central figure faces away from the viewer, bending over with its cloak lifted to reveal text. Two figures are bending down, looking towards the central figure, and holding a piece of fabric framing the text. The fourth person is standing on the left side, facing the central figure, wearing round glasses, and holding a stick. The figures have exaggerated facial features, including long, pointy noses and furrowed expressions. They wear robes, coats, and have varied hair styles. One figure carries a bag. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man Preparing to Draw his Sword
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caricatured figure with exaggerated features. The figure is in a dynamic pose, wearing a large, floppy hat that obscures part of the face and a loose-fitting, heavily detailed garment. The lines are bold, emphasizing the contours of the form. There is a sense of motion suggested by the forward-leaning posture and the placement of the feet. The figure holds a stick or staff under one arm, enhancing the sense of movement and action within the composition. The style suggests a focus on lines and exaggerated forms, lending a whimsical, satirical quality to the image.

artworks.title: The Hooded Cripple
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a collection of curved and angular lines forming an abstract figure. The figure resembles a cross between a fish and a human, with fins, arms, legs, a head with features resembling a beak and whiskers, a bulky rounded body, an upright stance, a stick for support, and a long flowing tail.

artworks.title: The Hunchback with a Cane
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile view, walking with a bent posture and supporting themselves on a stick with their right hand. The person has a round face with large eyes, a small mouth, short hair under a large hat with a plume. They are wearing a loose garment that drapes over their shoulders and body, puffing out around their chest and back, giving them a hunchbacked appearance. The surroundings are minimal, with only the suggestion of a ground line beneath the person's feet and a plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Cripple with Crutch and Wooden Leg
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure walking with two crutches. The line art depicts a person bundled in heavy clothing that conceals most of their form, emphasizing a hunched back and a determined stride. The facial expression conveys strain or effort, and the background is devoid of detail. The lines suggest an expressionist style.

artworks.title: The Drinker, Front View
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a person from the waist up in a dynamic pose, stepping forward with one knee raised. The person is looking upwards with their head tilted back, eyes wide open. They have a round face with a small chin and distinct eyebrows, short hair, and wear loose, striped clothing with billowy sleeves. The individual is holding a small cup in their right hand and a jug with a ringed design in their left hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Drinker, Back View
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upside-down figure in a headstand position. The person has a round body with hands reaching towards the ground, wearing a striped tunic and baggy pants. The figure has no visible facial features and is set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Duellist with Two Sabers
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a creature holding two swords. The creature has exaggerated facial features and is depicted in a dynamic stance with one sword in each hand. The attire is reminiscent of a medieval style. The lines and shading are simple yet effective, giving the drawing a bold appearance. The creature's expression and posed stance suggest movement and intensity. The style is similar to historical illustrations using etching techniques.

artworks.title: Duellist with Sword and Dagger
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a fencing stance. They have one foot forward, arms extended holding a fencing sword and a dagger. The person wears traditional loose-fitting clothing and a wide-brimmed hat. The figure is drawn without a detailed background, on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Man with Big Belly
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with one arm outstretched. The person has a rounded face, small eyes, a broad nose, and thick hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a large doublet with puffed sleeves, fitted pants, shoes, and a belt. A sword handle is visible on the left side. The setting is minimal, with the person standing on the ground, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Hunchback with the Feathered Cap
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a short, stout figure seen from behind, with a large body and a slight forward lean. They wear a floppy hat with curls, long curly hair, a billowing shirt with folds and buttons, tight pants, pointy shoes, and a sword at their side. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Potbellied Man with the Tall Hat
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a short-statured figure walking or leaning forward. The figure has a large head with exaggerated facial features, long wavy hair flowing from under a large hat with feathers, a loosely fitting jacket, skirt-like garment, simple shoes, and is holding a cane in the left hand and resting the right hand on the hip. The background is plain with a simple line suggestive of the ground.

artworks.title: The Violin Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a character playing the violin. The character has exaggerated, cartoonish features, such as large eyes and a wrinkled face. The character wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, and the brim is swept back as if caught by the wind. The attire includes a tunic, belt, and puffy pants. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of 17th-century caricatures, highlighting the character's playful and humorous design.

artworks.title: Masked Man with Twisted Feet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a character standing confidently with one hand on its hip and the other on its head. The character has exaggerated facial features, including a large nose, wide eyes, and long, flowing hair with two prominent strands. It is wearing a long coat, trousers, and high boots with heels. The character is holding an oval object in its left hand and has a sword hanging from its waist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Lute Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a musicians' stance. The person has exaggerated features including a long nose and expressive, slightly slanted eyes. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, a loose, long-sleeved garment, layered trousers, and striped tights. They hold a stringed instrument akin to a lute. The background is plain with minimal detail.

artworks.title: The Hurdy-Gurdy Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a hunched position, possibly walking or resting. The facial features include deep-set eyes and a prominent nose. The person is wearing a large hat with long ribbon-like elements, a long coat, and layered clothing with textured pants. They are holding round objects in their left hand. The background is plain with subtle markings.

artworks.title: The Flageolet Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish figure walking to the right in a hunched-over position. The figure has exaggerated facial features, wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a sprig of leaves, a long robe, pants, shoes, and playing a wind instrument. The background is plain with subtle line work suggesting a ground.

artworks.title: Man Scraping a Grill
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a strange figure playing a musical instrument. The figure has exaggerated features, such as an elongated nose, a hunchback, and irregular limbs. The character is dressed in a simple garment and appears to be energetically playing the instrument. The instrument is fantastical with pendulum-like elements hanging from it. The drawing has bold and well-defined lines, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The Bagpipe Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person playing bagpipes in a slightly crouched position. They have distinctive facial features, including a prominent nose and high cheekbones, and a focused expression. The person has medium-length hair and is dressed in a tunic-like garment with long sleeves and thigh-length. They are wearing leg coverings, and the background is a plain, blank expanse. The illustration is in a monochrome pen-and-ink style with simple lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Masked Comedian Playing a Guitar
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.3 × 7.5 cm (2 1/2 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a lively pose, playing a stringed musical instrument. The person has exaggerated facial features and is wearing a long coat, trousers, and shoes with heels. They have a large hat with a feather and carry a pack on their back. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Guitar Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person holding a stringed instrument in a dynamic stance. The person has exaggerated facial features, unkempt hair flowing back, and is wearing loose-fitting clothes with a belt. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Capricci"
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative text with mythical creatures. The image features intricate decorative elements surrounding a central text. Two muscular mythical creatures frame the text at the top corners. The lower part of the scroll has eye designs. The text within the scroll is presented in varied typography, suggestive of a classical or baroque style. The composition creates a sense of grandeur and artistic flair.
